hypotheses.name: Short impulse continuation
hypotheses.trigger: On completed 1s aggregate: 5s log-return z-score >= 2.5 (short <= -2.5) relative to trailing 60s realized volatility, and 5s quote/trade count exceeds the same-time-of-day trailing 30m 90th percentile.
jev_questions: Choose continuation, range, or reversal over next 10s
Noul: is expected edge positive after costs?
hypotheses.risk_exit: Exit at timeout, opposite z trigger, or the tighter of 1.0x recent 1s volatility adverse move and account risk cap.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if OOS net 10s markout fails to beat both no-model z-momentum and zero after costs.

hypotheses.name: Short-horizon overextension fade
hypotheses.trigger: 3s cumulative return absolute z >= 3; next 1s return reverses; price is >=2x 1s volatility from 5s VWAP; spread <=10bp and feed fresh.
hypotheses.risk_exit: Exit at VWAP reversion, 10s maximum, or impulse extreme plus 0.5x 5s volatility stop.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if OOS 5s/15s net markout or adverse-selection tail does not improve versus a fixed contrarian rule.

hypotheses.name: L2 imbalance with price confirmation
hypotheses.trigger: Sequence-valid top-5 depth imbalance >0.6 (<-0.6 short) for 3 updates, followed by at least one tick same-direction mid confirmation in the next second.
hypotheses.risk_exit: Exit on imbalance reversal, invalidated price confirmation, sequence gap or timeout.
hypotheses.falsification: Only test after raw L2 collection; reject if 1/3/5s executable net markout is <=0 or edge vanishes after excluding gaps.

hypotheses.name: Aggressor-flow exhaustion reversal
hypotheses.trigger: Rolling 1s signed quote-volume delta has 10s z-score >3, mid fails to make a new extreme in the same direction, and same-direction top-of-book depth recovers on two updates.
hypotheses.risk_exit: Exit on flow re-acceleration, adverse price bound, or 5s timeout.
hypotheses.falsification: Reject if OOS net markout/executability does not beat price-only contrarian baseline after latency and costs.

hypotheses.name: Funding/mark dislocation execution veto
hypotheses.trigger: Within 60s of funding settlement with predicted funding or mark-index basis above trailing 24h 99th percentile, or mark/last basis 30s z-score >3.
hypotheses.risk_exit: This is an execution veto overlay, not a direction-entry signal; deterministic leverage and exposure caps dominate.
hypotheses.falsification: Matched settlement-window samples must show improved cost-adjusted tail risk or fill quality; otherwise reject overlay.

risk_and_cost_assumptions.fee_note: Provisional one-way 5bp maker and 10bp taker assumptions each way; not verified exchange fees or user tier.
